description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Mulannatuwa, Galnewa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - (25/0192)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of title determination for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their locations, cadastral maps, and ownership determinations (all showing "The State" as owner), which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category definition for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
